claims.text: The resort opened in February 2009.

findings.quote: February 2009

claims.text: The resort has 67 rooms in total.

findings.quote: Total Number of Rooms:
findings.note: Total rooms listed as 67 on next line

claims.text: The resort is in a secluded private bay on Mahe, the main island of the Seychelles.

findings.quote: Secluded private bay on the country's main island of Mahe, 30 minutes by land from the airport

claims.text: The resort is nestled into a lush hillside leading down to a white-sand beach.

findings.quote: Nestled into a lush hillside leading down to a white-sand beach

claims.text: Every villa has its own infinity pool.

findings.quote: Every villa has its own infinity pool, deck, outdoor shower and open-air reading pavilion with daybed

claims.text: The resort's design is local Creole style with extensive use of wood and stone.

findings.quote: Local Creole style with extensive use of wood and stone in a series of indoor and outdoor pavilions

claims.text: Le Syel Spa has 8 treatment rooms.

findings.quote: Number of Treatment Rooms:

claims.text: Le Syel Spa is located at the uppermost point of the resort, with sweeping Indian Ocean views.

findings.quote: Located at the uppermost point of the Resort, far above Petite Anse bay, with sweeping Indian Ocean views

claims.text: Koi is the resort's Japanese restaurant.

findings.quote: Take a seat before the chef’s counter in our intimate Japanese restaurant and watch as our culinary team prepares sushi platters, tempura, signature rolls and savoury appetizers, with the hills of Petite Anse serving as a backdrop.

claims.text: Steak Shack serves premium grilled meat, seafood and vegetables.

findings.quote: Premium grilled meat, seafood and vegetables

claims.text: Il Forno is an Italian restaurant located directly on the beach.

findings.quote: Located directly on the beach, Il Forno brings authentic Italian dining to a relaxed seaside setting with an open kitchen and glowing oven at its heart.

claims.text: The fitness center is 128 sq m.

findings.quote: 128 sq m / 1,380 sq ft

claims.text: The Hilltop Ocean-View Villa has a wraparound plunge pool that looks onto the bay.

findings.quote: With views like this, chances are you’ll never want to leave your villa’s deep sunken tub or wraparound plunge pool, which looks onto the bay from a perch high above the island’s granite terrain.

claims.text: Serenity Villas are one-bedroom villas designed with romance in mind.

findings.quote: Designed with romance in mind, these one-bedroom villas are some of our most private, surrounded by lush jungle greenery and expansive views across Petite Anse bay.

claims.text: In the Two-Bedroom Ocean-View Suite, each bedroom is housed within its own pavilion.

findings.quote: Each of the suite’s two bedrooms is housed within its own pavilion, separated by a private pool and deck where you can come together for a swim or toast the sunset as often as you choose.

claims.text: A Floating Breakfast in the Pool is served on a floating tray in your villa's plunge pool.

findings.quote: Slip into your swimsuit and add the floating tray to your plunge pool to start the day in unforgettable style.

claims.text: The Miracle of Coco De Mer is a five step spa ritual that includes a bath overlooking the bay.

findings.quote: This five step ritual includes a body scrub and mask, body butter massage, bath overlooking the bay and application of body lotion.

claims.text: Seychelles International Airport is 18 km from the resort.

findings.quote: Travel Time35 minutes by carDistance18 km/11 miles
